learning_outcomes.text: Analyze the apprentice's journey in the company.
Demonstrate acquired skills during company periods.
Project oneself as an Engineer, considering organizational, scientific and technical, human, and economic dimensions.
Demonstrate the ability to lead a project by taking into account organizational, scientific and technical, human, and economic dimensions.
Analyze a solution, propose and implement solutions, measure and analyze the effects of what has been achieved, propose ways for improvement.

syllabus_topics: Evolution of the apprentice during company periods
Acquired skills in the company during the third year
Organizational and human dimensions of the project

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation grid filled by the Industrial Tutor
Final Study Project report writing and defense

assessment_rules: The evaluation is based on the electronic monitoring logbook, the evaluation grid filled by the industrial tutor at the end of the third year, and the writing and defense of the Final Study Project (PFE) report. Competencies are assessed through activities with three levels: 'knows how to do under control', 'knows how to do autonomously', and 'knows how to do and can train'.
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
